resources.string: Turn SHIP into SHIPS to score 11 points.
Tap the S on the rack below the board.
It’s the square just to the right of SHIP. 2L doubles the value of S.
You can see your score before playing. Tap Play move to see the result.
Clear your placement, then place only the S on H12.
Well played. The 2L square doubled the value of S.
The first word covers the center star. After that, connect to a letter on the board. New tiles must form a single row or column. Every word created must be in the built-in dictionary.

Add the tile values of the words you form. 2L and L3 multiply a letter. 2W and 3W multiply the word. Bonuses apply the first time you cover a square. A blank tile is worth zero. Playing all seven tiles in one move earns 50 extra points.
NAB is your solo opponent. Its engine looks for legal moves in the built-in dictionary. Adaptive difficulty uses your local Elo and the score difference during the game.
The engine checks the move and its score. The built-in SmolLM2 model uses those facts to explain a bonus square, a crossing word, or another detail. NAB and the explanations work in airplane mode.

To import a word list you have permission to use, go to Profile → Settings → Personal dictionary. Android practice validates words as you play and has no clock. FISF tournament rules use a clock and allow the opponent to challenge words after a move is played.
